{{Top|leg}}
A '''Love-Wallop pill''' was a pill that could be added to [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] in an attempt to lower the drinker's inhibitions. [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]] the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] sold them for a high price at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="Nightlily">{{StoryCite|story=Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Feltipern Trevagg/Legends|Feltipern Trevagg]] purchased and employed one during his seduction of the [[H'nemthe (species)/Legends|H'nemthe]] [[M'iiyoom Onith/Legends|M'iiyoom Onith]], leading to his own [[Death/Legends|death]] when she [[H'nemthe mating ritual|eviscerated]] him afterward.<ref name="Nightlily" />
